publicMaterial.name: runtime-grammar
publicMaterial.value:
; Lico Arc Core v1 Pairwise Protection runtime grammar.
; Every map is deterministic, definite-length CBOR with shortest integers.
; Unknown/duplicate labels, indefinite lengths, non-shortest integers and
; trailing bytes are terminal invalid-encoding.

support-entry = {
  0 => tstr .size (1..128),          ; source/catalog wireId locator
  1 => 1..9007199254740991,          ; generation
  2 => bstr .size 32                 ; Protocol Line content identity
}

support-statement = {
  0 => bstr .size 32,                ; identity-state digest
  1 => 1..9007199254740991,          ; monotonic floor
  2 => [1*16 support-entry],          ; sorted by generation, line ID, wireId
  3 => bstr .size 32,                ; Ed25519 identity key reference
  4 => bstr .size 32,                ; ML-DSA-65 identity key reference
  5 => bstr .size 64,                ; strict plain Ed25519 signature
  6 => bstr .size 3309               ; exact ML-DSA-65 signature
}

prekey-bundle = {
  0 => bstr .size 32,                ; Protocol Line content identity
  1 => bstr .size 32,                ; Protection Profile content identity
  2 => bstr .size 32,                ; responder identity-state digest
  3 => bstr .size 32,                ; Ed25519 identity key reference
  4 => bstr .size 32,                ; ML-DSA-65 identity key reference
  5 => 1..9007199254740991,          ; globally monotonic pair sequence
  6 => bstr .size 32,                ; raw X25519 one-time public key
  7 => bstr .size 1184,              ; final ML-KEM-768 encapsulation key
  8 => 0..9007199254740991,          ; Unix-second validFrom, inclusive
  9 => 1..9007199254740991,          ; Unix-second validUntil, exclusive
  10 => bstr .size 64,               ; strict plain Ed25519 signature
  11 => bstr .size 3309              ; exact ML-DSA-65 signature
}

first-packet = {
  0 => support-statement,            ; initiator complete support and floor
  1 => support-statement,            ; responder complete support and floor
  2 => bstr .size 32,                ; selected Protocol Line identity
  3 => bstr .size 32,                ; selected Profile identity
  4 => bstr .size 32,                ; initiator identity-state digest
  5 => bstr .size 32,                ; responder identity-state digest
  6 => prekey-bundle,
  7 => bstr .size 32,                ; fresh raw X25519 initiator public key
  8 => bstr .size 1088,              ; final ML-KEM-768 ciphertext
  9 => bstr .size 32,                ; initiator Ed25519 key reference
  10 => bstr .size 32,               ; initiator ML-DSA-65 key reference
  11 => bstr .size 64,               ; strict plain Ed25519 signature
  12 => bstr .size 3309,             ; exact ML-DSA-65 signature
  13 => bstr .size 36,               ; encrypted fixed client-confirm bytes
  14 => bstr .size 16                ; ChaCha20-Poly1305 tag
}

session-accept = {
  0 => bstr .size 32,                ; complete first-packet transcript digest
  1 => bstr .size 32,                ; committed session-context digest
  2 => bstr .size 32,                ; responder identity-state digest
  3 => 1..9007199254740991,          ; redeemed pair sequence
  4 => bstr .size 32                 ; full HMAC-SHA-256, never truncated
}

ratchet-header = {
  0 => bstr .size 32,                ; current raw X25519 ratchet public key
  1 => 0..4294967295,                ; PN, previous sending-chain length
  2 => 0..4294967295                 ; N, current message number
}

protected-record = (
  ratchet-header-bytes: bstr .size (40..48),
  ciphertext: bstr .size (0..524224),
  tag: bstr .size 16
)

; On the wire, protected-record is the complete canonical ratchet-header CBOR
; bytes followed directly by ciphertext and the 16-byte tag; the tuple above
; describes framing components rather than an enclosing CBOR array.
; AAD is the exact record-AAD domain, 32-byte session-context digest, and the
; complete ratchet-header bytes. A Profile selector, session ID, nonce or
; algorithm choice is never repeated in an established record.

dualAuthentication.ed25519: plain Ed25519 over the complete signatureInput; no prehash and no context variant
dualAuthentication.mlDsa65: ML-DSA-65 verification over the same complete signatureInput with empty external context
dualAuthentication.keyAuthority: both referenced keys must be active for the exact identity state and operation purpose

bundleValidity.relation: validFrom < validUntil and validUntil - validFrom <= MAX_BUNDLE_VALIDITY_SPAN_SECONDS using checked integer arithmetic
bundleValidity.eligibility: the responder and initiator each require its trusted Endpoint clock to be within the half-open interval [validFrom, validUntil) during validation
bundleValidity.expiryMutation: none; expiry neither reserves, redeems nor removes an active pair

hybridKeySchedule.sessionContextDigest: SHA-256(sessionContext-domain || deterministic-CBOR([protocolLineId, protectionProfileId, handshakeTranscriptDigest, initiatorIdentityStateDigest, responderIdentityStateDigest, pairSequence]))

confirmation.clientCiphertext: ChaCha20-Poly1305(clientConfirmKey, clientConfirmNonce, clientPlaintext, clientAad) as ciphertext || tag

ratchetKeySchedule.directionRule: the sender and receiver of an initiator-to-responder chain both use I2R domains; both sides of a responder-to-initiator chain use R2I domains
ratchetKeySchedule.bootstrapRule: only the initiator-to-responder chain exists at commit; the responder must create a fresh local ratchet key and perform the first R2I root/chain step before its first established send

record.body: ChaCha20-Poly1305 ciphertext followed immediately by the 16-byte tag

value.tentativeRule: all parsing-derivation-authentication-and-bound-checks-use-an-isolated snapshot; only the named atomic commit may mutate durable state
